|game_text=Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a senator for remainder of turn.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Astromech Shortage (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-astromechshortage-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-31-Astromech_Shortage.png]]); both show this text. The PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Astromech Shortage (V) (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 31: “Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a senator for remainder of turn.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) shows the same text.<ref name="cl-1210_31-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Astromech Shortage (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, slip marked E) changed “a senator” to “a non-[Theed Palace] senator”: “Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a non-[Theed Palace] senator for remainder of turn.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=23, page 23. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=23 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee reposted this errata on its rules forum on 30 April 2013, as “already released errata”<ref name="pcforum-p805875">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 30 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p805875 forum post])</ref>.
